prompt: Complete DateMath: daysBetween returns the absolute number of days between two LocalDates, and nextMonday returns the first Monday strictly after a given date.
explanation: ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(a, b) counts whole days from a to b and is negative when b is earlier, so wrapping it in Math.abs gives the order-independent distance. TemporalAdjusters.next(DayOfWeek.MONDAY) is a ready-made adjuster that moves to the FIRST Monday after the date -- strictly after, so a Monday input jumps a full week (nextOrSame would instead return the same day). LocalDate values are immutable; d.with(...) returns a new date and never modifies d.
hints: ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(a, b) already counts the days -- but the result is negative when b is before a.
Math.abs(...) turns that signed count into the required non-negative distance.
d.with(TemporalAdjusters.next(DayOfWeek.MONDAY)) gives the first Monday after d; note that next(...) skips d itself, unlike nextOrSame(...). A manual plusDays loop checking getDayOfWeek() also works.
